# What is ReAuthenticate™?

### Onboard users in minutes, not days

ReAuthenticate™ makes onboarding quick and easy. Forget about filling out forms or scanning IDs. With just a selfie, our smart technology verifies your users instantly. Enjoy higher conversions, happier users, and significant savings in both time and money with this FREE KYC.

![reauth_onboard.svg](https://authenticate.com/static/reauth_onboard-3cffcea449a663ae0b0615c0d22d77f2.svg)

### Onboard users in minutes, not days

### Simplify Compliance, Simplify Lives: Effortless KYC with ReAuthenticate™

With KYC you must use no less than two factors of authentication to prove identity. ReAuthenticate™ makes compliance a breeze, allowing businesses and end users to enjoy a smooth, mobile-friendly onboarding experience. If we've verified this user before, then with just a selfie we can ensure our secure solution meets your regulatory requirements.

![reauth_kyc.svg](https://authenticate.com/static/reauth_kyc-9bb32ca821647acdd3da3b7e5c8039e4.svg)

### Simplify Compliance, Simplify Lives: Effortless KYC with ReAuthenticate™

### Scale seamlessly to accommodate your growing user base

ReAuthenticate™ can manage surging demand without compromising speed, accuracy, and user experience. Perfect for rapidly growing businesses, ReAuthenticate™ ensures you are always KYC compliant. Any entity, large or small can enjoy this seamless solution with peace of mind and reliability.

![reauth_scale.svg](https://authenticate.com/static/reauth_scale-6b4b100356ce46e097f7da799ca8ad46.svg)

# Benefits

## Enhanced User Experience

By minimizing the steps required for repeat verification's, users enjoy a more seamless interaction, reducing dropout rates.

## Improved Efficiency

By minimizing the steps required for repeat verification's, users enjoy a more seamless interaction with services, reducing dropout rates during the verification process.

## Cost-Effective

Reducing the need for multiple, comprehensive KYC checks for repeat users can lower operational costs.

## Compliance and Security

Maintains high standards of security and regulatory compliance by ensuring that initial verifications are thorough and by using advanced technology for subsequent checks.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about the ReAuthenticate™.

### What types of photo documents does ReAuthenticate™ accept?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

ReAuthenticate™ accepts selfies for authentication. Alternatively, if the selfie doesn’t match, it accepts any Government-Issued Photo IDs.

### What is the pricing for ReAuthenticate™?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

ReAuthenticate™ is a free service.

### Can you customize the ReAuthenticate™ experience to match your brand and workflow?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Yes, ReAuthenticate™ can match your brand and workflow.

### Can ReAuthenticate™ offer seamless integration with your existing user management system or other relevant platforms?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

ReAuthenticate™ and Medallion™ have the same integration methods available via APIs or our integrations.
